document.about: USGS Techniques and Methods 5-B13 (doi:10.3133/tm5B13). Each even page heads with the title of the section it is in, and the bookmarks point at their sections by named destinations.

notes: #256: bookmarks named their destinations, which were not read, so every block reading a bookmark's title was the bookmark's heading: the running head `Appendix 1. Supplemental Figures` on 32 even pages, and `Background`, `Summary of Method` and their like on the pages of their sections. A bookmark now heads the one place nearest where it lands, and the copies standing where others stand on other pages are a running line.

checks.issue: The even-page running head `Appendix 1. Supplemental Figures` was an h1 on every even page from 68 to 134.
